prompts.baseline: Solve the user's problem. Return ONLY one valid JSON object with explanation (a concise derivation) and final_answer (a string in the format requested by the question). Put explanation before final_answer. Do not use LaTeX, Markdown, or text outside JSON.
prompts.template_bounded: Solve the user's problem. Return ONLY one valid JSON object with explanation (a concise derivation) and final_answer (a string in the format requested by the question). Put explanation before final_answer. Do not use LaTeX, Markdown, or text outside JSON. Use exactly the two string fields in this JSON template, replacing both placeholders with your own content: {"explanation":"BRIEF CALCULATION","final_answer":"ANSWER IN THE FORMAT REQUESTED BY THE QUESTION"}. Keep explanation to at most 60 words. Include both fields and finish the JSON object.

analysis_plan.primary_population: fresh (12 questions); regression (8 inspected items) reported separately
analysis_plan.strict_correctness: same diagnostic answer contract as baseline; numerical tolerance 0.001; no answer extracted from explanation
limitations: Template and explanation bound are bundled; their separate effects are not identified.
One matched seed per item; known regression stages sharing an urn are dependent.
Joint-valid accuracy is a selected subset affected by the intervention, reported only as a secondary diagnostic.
analysis_plan.no_adaptation: Frozen before inference; no prompt retuning, answer retries, or gold feedback.
